title: Communities
subtitle: Find a place to play: community servers, their regular players and their links

errors.notFound: JKNet Online has no such community page.
errors.unauthorized: JKNet Online refused the session. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You cannot do that on this page.
errors.limit: A limit of JKNet Online stops this: {{message}}
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests to JKNet Online. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: JKNet Online did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
errors.conflict: JKNet Online could not apply that: {{message}}
errors.providerError: The game server did not answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.internal: JKNet Online has a problem of its own. Try again later.

catalog.noResultsHint: Pick another tag, clear the search or choose another language or region.
catalog.emptyHint: A community appears here once its owner confirms a server.

follow.promptText: Your subscriptions are kept in your JKNet Online account.

mine.signInTitle: Sign in to see your communities
mine.signInText: The communities you run as their owner or an editor are gathered here.
mine.emptyTitle: You do not run a community yet
mine.emptyText: Create a community for your server, or ask the owner of one to make you an editor.
mine.note: Communities where you are the owner or an editor, and the ones you created before confirming a server.
mine.noteAdmin: A JKNet administrator can edit any community. Here are the ones you created or run.

following.signInText: Follow communities to keep their pages one click away.
following.emptyTitle: You do not follow a community yet
following.emptyText: Follow a community from the catalog, and it appears here.
following.note: The bell turns the notifications of a community on or off.

create.title: Create community
create.body: A community starts with its first server. It appears in the catalog once you confirm that you run the server.
create.name: Name
create.addressHint: A public IPv4 address and port. If JKNet already knows the server, its community opens.
create.label: Server label
create.labelHint: Optional: what the page calls this server, such as Duel or RP. Up to 40 characters.
create.invalidAddress: Enter a public IPv4 address with a port, such as 203.0.113.15:29070.

page.notFound: The page does not exist or was removed.
page.shareFailed: The link could not be copied: {{link}}

about.title: About the community
about.empty: The organizers have not described the community yet.

play.title: Play
play.unverifiedHint: Only the organizers see this server until its code is checked.
play.noServers: The community has no public servers yet.
play.launcherNote: Join from the JKNet launcher: it installs the recommended files and connects in one click.

launcher.noClient: Create a client for {{game}} to play here.
launcher.running: Close the running game before installing or connecting.
launcher.stopped: Installation stopped. Completed files remain installed.
launcher.wrongGame: This file is for a different game.
launcher.conflicts: Some files already exist with different contents. Open the JKHub entry to review and replace them.
launcher.unsupported: This entry needs manual installation. Open its JKHub page.

discord.title: Discord · {{name}}
discord.widgetOffText: Players see the invite only. Turn the widget on, and the page shows the voice channels and the members online.
discord.path: In Discord: Server Settings, Widget, Enable Server Widget
discord.recheck: JKNet checks the widget again in 3 minutes.
discord.invalidText: The link expired or was deleted. Players do not see the Discord card until it is replaced.
discord.invalidTextBot: The link expired or was deleted. Players see what the JKNet bot reads, but cannot join the server until the link is replaced.
discord.unavailable: Discord did not answer just now. The invite still works.

bot.badgeHint: The JKNet bot reads this Discord server
bot.connectHint: Connect the JKNet bot to show the text channels and announcements of your Discord server here.

files.title: Recommended files
files.installInLauncher: The JKNet launcher installs them into a client in one click.

servers.organizerLead: Organizers also see the servers that are not verified yet.

claim.title: Is this your server?
claim.text: Confirm that you run it: put a code into its name, or ask a JKNet administrator to check.
claim.signIn: Sign in to claim the server
claim.codeHint: Temporarily add this code to sv_hostname, separated by spaces. Keep it there until verification finishes.
claim.pendingManual: Your request is awaiting administrator review. You do not need to change the server name.
claim.approved: Ownership confirmed. You can restore the original server name and edit this page.
claim.rejected: The request was declined. You can contact a JKNet administrator or request another verification.

players.lead: JKNet players who play on the community's servers regularly: {{count}}.
players.limit: The list shows the first {{shown}} of {{total}}.
players.privacy: Do not want to be on the list? Hide yourself in the settings.
players.privacyLauncher: A player hides themselves from the list in the settings of the JKNet launcher.

news.title: News
news.emptyOrganizer: No news yet. Write the first post: the followers with notifications on get it at once.
news.deleteText: «{{title}}» disappears from the community page. This cannot be undone.
news.saved: The changes of the post are saved.

push.title: Community news
push.hint: Posts of the communities you follow with notifications on

composer.note: Followers with notifications on get it at once
composer.title: Title
composer.pinFull: {{max}} posts are pinned already: unpin one of them to pin this one.
composer.titleOneLine: Keep the title on one line.
composer.titleTooLong: The title is longer than {{max}} characters.
composer.bodyRequired: Write the text of the post.
composer.bodyTooLong: The text is longer than {{max}} characters.
composer.pinLimit: A community pins three posts at most. Unpin one of the pinned posts, then pin this one.
composer.changed: Someone changed the post meanwhile. Reload the page and make your change again.

activity.title: When people play here
activity.fewDays_one: Little data yet: JKNet has watched the servers for {{count}} day. The map grows accurate within a week.
activity.fewDays_other: Little data yet: JKNet has watched the servers for {{count}} days. The map grows accurate within a week.
activity.noData: No data yet: JKNet started watching the servers of this community recently.

manage.title: Manage: {{name}}

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: The page has changes you did not save. If you leave now, they are lost.

bot.lead: The JKNet bot adds the text channels and the announcements of {{name}} to the page.
bot.leadPlain: The JKNet bot adds the text channels and the announcements of your Discord server to the page.
bot.readsChannels: Reads the list of text channels everyone on the server sees.
bot.readsAnnouncements: Reads the announcements of one channel you choose.
bot.permissions: Discord asks you to pick the server and allow the bot to view channels and read the message history.
bot.waitingText: Add the bot to the server on the page that opened, then come back here: the screen checks the connection by itself.
bot.linkedTo: The bot is connected to {{name}}. It reads the server every 5 minutes, last at {{time}}.
bot.linkedToPlain: The bot is connected to your Discord server. It reads it every 5 minutes, last at {{time}}.
bot.waitingRead: The bot is connected. It reads the server within a few minutes.
bot.unknown: JKNet Online did not say how the bot is doing. Reload the page to ask again.
bot.disabled: The JKNet bot is not enabled on JKNet Online yet.
bot.noChannels: The bot has found no channel everyone on the server sees.
bot.channelHint: The page shows the 5 latest messages of this channel.
bot.channelCleared: The page shows no announcements now.
bot.showChannels: Show text channels on the page
bot.channelsShown: The page lists the text channels.
bot.channelsHidden: The page lists no text channels now.
bot.disconnectText: The bot leaves {{name}}, and the page stops showing its channels and announcements. You can connect it again.
bot.disconnectTextPlain: The bot leaves your Discord server, and the page stops showing its channels and announcements. You can connect it again.
bot.notRead: The bot has not read the channels of the server yet. Try again in a few minutes.
bot.mismatch: The bot reads another Discord server than the one the invite of the community leads to. Connect it to the server of the invite, or replace the invite.

errors.noAccess: The bot lost the Discord server: it was removed, or its role cannot view the channels. Connect it again.
errors.announcementsHidden: Not everyone on the server sees the announcements channel. Choose another channel, or open this one to everyone.
errors.announcementsHistoryHidden: Everyone on the server sees the announcements channel but cannot read its history. Let everyone read its message history, or choose another channel.
errors.announcementsDenied: The bot cannot read the announcements channel. Give it View Channels and Read Message History in that channel.
errors.botToken: Discord refused the bot of JKNet Online. The JKNet team has to fix it; the page keeps what the bot read last.
errors.unavailable: Discord did not answer the bot. It tries again within 5 minutes.

manage.signInTitle: Sign in to manage the community
manage.signInText: The owner, the editors and the JKNet administrators manage a community page.
manage.noAccessText: The owner, the editors and the JKNet administrators change this page.
manage.deletedText: The page, its servers, editors, followers and pictures are gone. The addresses of its servers are free again.

problems.oneLine: Keep it on one line, without tabs.
problems.https: Enter a link that starts with https://.
problems.invite: Use an invite link: https://discord.gg/CODE or https://discord.com/invite/CODE.
problems.linkHost: The address does not lead to {{site}}.
problems.linkEmpty: Enter the address or remove the link.
problems.fileTitle: Enter the title of the file.
problems.fileLink: Enter a JKHub file link or the number of the file.
problems.fileDuplicate: This file is on the list already.
problems.bundle: Enter the id of a bundle or a link to it.

profile.name: Name
profile.taglineHint: One line under the name, on the page and on the card.
profile.descriptionPlaceholder: Who you are, when you play and how to join

editor.heading: Heading
editor.linkText: Where the selected text leads. Players open it in their browser.
editor.linkInvalid: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.

images.logoLimits: Square, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MiB.
images.coverLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 3 MiB, best at 3:1.
images.noLogo: Without a logo, the page shows the first letters of the name.
images.noCover: Without a cover, the header takes the colour of the community.
images.unsaved: Shown on the page after you save
images.removedUnsaved: Leaves the page after you save
images.several: Drop one picture at a time.
images.notPicture: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.

links.websiteHint: Optional. Opens in the player's browser.
links.discordHint: Optional. The invite shows the Discord card on the page.
links.discordUnsaved: JKNet checks the invite after you save.
links.discordInvalid: Discord does not know this invite, or it expired. Create an invite that never expires.
links.discordNotInvite: This link is not an invite: players see no Discord card. Paste an invite link.
links.discordUnavailable: Discord did not answer. JKNet checks the invite again later.
links.addHint: HTTPS only. The address leads to the site of its kind.

files.lead: JKHub files players install before they join. The launcher installs them in this order.
files.title: Title of file {{number}}
files.link: JKHub link or number of file {{number}}
files.addHint: Paste the link of a JKHub file page, or the number of the file.

bundle.lead: A JKNet bundle the community recommends as its client. Players install it from the page.
bundle.removedUnsaved: The bundle leaves the page after you save.
bundle.failed: The bundle catalog did not load. Enter the id instead.
bundle.byIdHint: JKNet Online keeps only a bundle every player can see.

servers.lead: Players see the verified servers. A server belongs to one community.
servers.label: Label of {{address}}
servers.removeLast: Only an administrator removes the last server
servers.removeText: {{address}} leaves the community. To bring it back, it has to be verified again.
servers.addHint: Up to 10 servers. A new server is verified by a code in its name.
servers.full: The community has 10 servers, the most it can have.
servers.addressHint: A public IPv4 address and a port from 1024.
servers.adminNote: A server an administrator adds is verified at once.
servers.addressPrivate: Use a public address: players cannot reach a local one.
servers.onPage: This server is on the page already.
servers.taken: This server belongs to another community.
servers.takenUnproven: Another community lists this server without proof. Claim it from that community's page: a verified claim moves the server to a new community of yours.
servers.relay: This address belongs to the JKNet relay of private servers. Use the address of the game server.
servers.step1: Add the code to <0>sv_hostname</0> of the server, separated by spaces. For example: <1>{{example}}</1>
servers.step2: Press <0>Verify</0>: JKNet reads the name of the server.
servers.step3: Once it is verified, put the old name back.
servers.checking: Reading the name of the server…
servers.done: The server is verified. Put its old name back: the code is not needed anymore.
servers.codeMissing: The code is not in the name of the server. Add it, separated by spaces, and verify again.
servers.codeExpired: The code expired. Get a new one.
servers.wrongGame: The server answered, but not as a server of the chosen game.

team.leaveText: You stop managing {{name}}. The owner can make you an editor again.
team.addFriend: Add an editor from your friends
team.byIdAny: Or any account by its id
team.byIdWrong: An account id is 26 letters and digits.
team.full: The community has 20 editors, the most it can have.
team.transferText: The new owner gets every right on the page. You become an editor.
team.transferTextOther: The new owner gets every right on the page. {{name}} becomes an editor.
team.transferRule: Ownership goes to an editor or to one of your JKNet friends.
team.transferNone: Nobody to hand over to yet. Add an editor first.
team.noteOwner: A hand-over makes you an editor. Only the new owner can undo it.
team.noteEditor: The owner, {{name}}, names editors and hands over ownership.
team.noteEditorNoOwner: The owner names editors once the community has one.
team.noteAdmin: As an administrator you name any account: one of your friends, an editor or an account id.
team.noteAdminNoOwner: Assign an owner under Administration. Ownership can be handed over once there is one.

admin.assignHint: Without an owner, the page opens by its link only, unless you publish it in the catalog.
admin.assigned: {{name}} owns the community now. Its servers are verified.
admin.clearHint: The removed owner stays an editor. Remove them from the editors if needed.
admin.cleared: The owner is removed. {{name}} stays an editor.
admin.clearedNotEditor: The owner is removed, but {{name}} did not become an editor: {{reason}}
admin.featuredHint: The mark on the page and the first places of the catalog.
admin.listed: Show in the catalog without an owner
admin.listedOwned: The community has an owner: it is in the catalog anyway.
admin.listedOn: The page is in the catalog without an owner.
admin.listedOff: The page opens by its link only.
admin.deleteHint: Deletes the page, its servers, editors, followers and pictures. It cannot be undone.
admin.deleteText: {{name}} goes with its servers, editors, followers and pictures. Nothing of it comes back.

save.problems: Fix the fields marked in red, then save.
save.conflict: Someone changed the page while you edited it. Reload it and make your changes again.

summary.teamNote: The owner names editors among JKNet friends, up to 20.
summary.teamNoteAdmin: Assign an owner: they then add editors from their JKNet friends.
summary.inCatalog: The community is in the catalog
summary.listed: In the catalog without an owner
summary.notListed: Not in the catalog: the page opens by its link only
summary.inviteInvalid: The invite does not work: players do not see the Discord card
summary.inviteNotInvite: The Discord link is not an invite
summary.widgetOn: Widget on: voice channels and {{count, number}} online
summary.widgetOff: Widget off: players see the invite only
summary.openText: Texts and links, tags, files, servers, editors, logo and cover

privacy.title: Regular players of communities
privacy.toggle: Show me in the regular players of communities
privacy.text: Communities list the JKNet players who play on their servers regularly. Turning this off removes you from every list and deletes the playing time JKNet Online has counted.
privacy.unsupported: The JKNet Online service does not have this setting yet.
privacy.signedOut: Sign in to JKNet Online to choose whether communities list you.

site.title: Communities
site.intro: Find a community to play Jedi Academy and Jedi Outcast with: its servers, regular players and links.
site.signInHint: Complete sign-in in the opened tab, then return here.
site.loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
site.loginChoose: Choose how to sign in. A separate window will open.
site.loginCancelled: The sign-in window was closed. Choose a provider to try again.
site.loginBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Open it using the link below, or cancel and try again.
site.loginWindowHint: If you closed the sign-in window, try again or cancel.
